potential.model: Angelo-Moody-Baskes Ni-Al-H EAM; only Ni and H species used
potential.citation: J. E. Angelo, N. R. Moody and M. I. Baskes, Trapping of hydrogen to lattice defects in nickel, Modelling Simul. Mater. Sci. Eng. 3, 289-307 (1995).
potential.units: DYNAMO setfl, LAMMPS metal units (angstrom, eV)

scope: fixed-cell real Ni-H force/virial contracts and finite-step serial/process/task-batch/MPI equivalence
performance_scope: single measurement per mode, startup and count probe included; no speedup assertion
